segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: Hi everyone.
segments.zh: 大家好。

segments.en: My name is Kathryn and today we have an elementary level lesson for you.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们为您准备了一个初级课程。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we are dealing with a house that is filled with different types of bugs.
segments.zh: 今天我们正在处理一个充满不同类型虫子的房子。

segments.en: Ew, bugs.
segments.zh: 呃，虫子。

segments.en: Well, it's summertime so it's not that uncommon but not a pleasant thing to deal with.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在是夏天，所以这并不少见，但不是一件令人愉快的事情。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we're going to call an exterminator.
segments.zh: 所以我们要打电话给灭虫者。

segments.en: So you might be asking yourself what that is but before we explain, why don't you listen to the dialogue for the first time.
segments.zh: 所以你可能会问自己这是什么，但在我们解释之前，你为什么不先听一遍对话呢。

segments.en: Hi, did you call for an exterminator?
segments.zh: 您好，您叫了灭虫服务吗？

segments.en: Yes, thank goodness you're here.
segments.zh: 是的，谢天谢地，你在这里。

segments.en: These bugs are driving us crazy.
segments.zh: 这些虫子快把我们逼疯了。

segments.en: What sort of pests are we dealing with?
segments.zh: 我们正在处理什么样的害虫？

segments.en: We just bought this house and it is infected with just about everything.
segments.zh: 我们刚买了这栋房子，结果什么虫害鼠害都有。

segments.en: We have termites in the wood, cockroaches all over the place and last night I saw a huge rat out in the backyard.
segments.zh: 木头里有白蚁，蟑螂到处都是，昨晚我还在后院看见一只大老鼠。

segments.en: Well there's nothing that we can't handle.
segments.zh: 放心，没有什么虫害是我们对付不了的。

segments.en: I'll spray the floorboards and walls to get rid of the cockroaches but the termites will be harder to get rid of.
segments.zh: 我会在地板和墙上喷药灭蟑螂，不过白蚁比较难除。

segments.en: We will have to cover the entire house and fumigate it.
segments.zh: 得把整栋房子罩起来，做熏蒸处理。

segments.en: Unfortunately, that means you will have to find a place to stay for the next three days.
segments.zh: 不幸的是，这意味着您将不得不在接下来的三天内找到一个住宿的地方。

segments.en: No problem.
segments.zh: 没问题。

segments.en: Let's get rid of the bugs.
segments.zh: 赶紧把这些虫子除掉吧。

segments.en: Alright we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now we have six key words that we've chosen out for you.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们为您选择了六个关键词。

segments.en: Let's take a look at those now on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 现在让我们在语言要点环节来看看这些词。

segments.en: Well Marco you've already told our users the very first word that would be exterminator.
segments.zh: 好吧，Marco，你已经把第一个词告诉听众了，那就是 exterminator。

segments.en: What is an exterminator?
segments.zh: 什么是灭虫者？

segments.en: It's a person, right?
segments.zh: 这是一个人，对吧？

segments.en: That's right, it's a person that has the job to exterminate or to delete or eliminate different types of bugs or pests.
segments.zh: 没错，指一个人，他的工作就是消灭、清除或消除各种类型的虫子或害虫。

segments.en: So an exterminator's job is to kill bugs.
segments.zh: 所以灭虫者的工作是杀死虫子。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And usually an exterminator comes to your home or your office to do this, right?
segments.zh: 通常，灭虫者会到您家或您的办公室来做这件事，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So maybe in your house you have a lot of different types of bugs.
segments.zh: 所以也许在你家里有很多不同类型的虫子。

segments.en: Maybe you have, I don't know, spiders.
segments.zh: 也许你有，我不知道，蜘蛛。

segments.en: So an exterminator will come and he will try to get rid of the spiders.
segments.zh: 所以一个灭虫者会来，他会试图摆脱蜘蛛。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: So an exterminator in a general sense gets rid of pests.
segments.zh: 因此，一般意义上的灭虫者可以摆脱害虫。

segments.en: And pest is our next word.
segments.zh: 害虫是我们的下一个词。

segments.en: That's right, a pest.
segments.zh: 没错，害虫。

segments.en: Now we're talking about bugs and they can be considered a sort of pest.
segments.zh: 现在我们谈论的是虫子，它们可以被认为是一种害虫。

segments.en: Well pest though is a more general term, right?
segments.zh: 不过害虫是一个更笼统的术语，对吧？

segments.en: So you can say pest about something like rats or mice.
segments.zh: 所以像老鼠或小鼠之类的东西，你都可以称为 pest。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So basically some type of animal that is very annoying and also causes some sort of harm or danger.
segments.zh: 所以基本上是某种非常烦人的动物，也会造成某种伤害或危险。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So there was a movie if I remember correctly in the 1990s.
segments.zh: 所以如果我在 1990 年代没记错的话，有一部电影。

segments.en: It was terrible and it was called The Pest.
segments.zh: 那部电影很糟糕，片名就叫《The Pest》。

segments.en: Yeah, that's right.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: And it's all about this person who is very annoying.
segments.zh: 整部电影讲的就是这个非常烦人的人。

segments.en: So you can even say an annoying person or a bothersome person is a pest.
segments.zh: 所以你甚至可以说，一个烦人的人或一个讨人厌的人就是个 pest。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: You're such a pest.
segments.zh: 你真是个讨人厌的家伙。

segments.en: Okay, so obviously our home is filled with bugs and that's what the person said that it is infested.
segments.zh: 好吧，很明显我们家里到处都是虫子，那个人说的就是房子遭受了虫害。

segments.en: Okay, so a place like an office building or like you said Marco, a home is infested if it is filled with something.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以像办公楼这样的地方，或者像你说的 Marco，一栋房子，如果里面到处都是某种东西，就是被侵扰了。

segments.en: And so infested means it's filled with something bad.
segments.zh: 所以 infested 的意思是里面到处都是不好的东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So in this case the house is infested with bugs.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，房子里到处都是虫子。

segments.en: They're living upstairs, downstairs, in the basement, in the kitchen, they're everywhere.
segments.zh: 它们住在楼上、楼下、地下室、厨房里，它们无处不在。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And she said that we, well actually they have termites in the wood.
segments.zh: 她说我们，呃，其实是他们的木头里有白蚁。

segments.en: All right, so termites are a special kind of bug that almost always live in wood, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，所以白蚁是一种特殊的虫子，几乎总是生活在木头中，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: They're little bugs that I think eat the wood.
segments.zh: 它们是我认为吃木头的小虫子。

segments.en: And this is why they're so dangerous because they make the house weak because they eat off all the wood that supports it.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么它们如此危险的原因，因为它们使房子变得虚弱，因为它们吃掉了所有支撑它的木头。

segments.en: So we can say the house fell down because it was infested with termites.
segments.zh: 所以我们可以说房子倒塌了，因为它被白蚁侵扰了。

segments.en: That's right, termites.
segments.zh: 没错，白蚁。

segments.en: And also we have a very common pest or a bug.
segments.zh: 而且我们还有一个非常常见的害虫或虫子。

segments.en: We have cockroaches.
segments.zh: 我们有蟑螂。

segments.en: Oh, I hate these and they're everywhere this summer.
segments.zh: 哦，我讨厌这些，今年夏天它们无处不在。

segments.en: Cockroaches come in different sizes.
segments.zh: 蟑螂有不同的大小。

segments.en: Some are big, some are small, but they're very, very strong bugs.
segments.zh: 有些是大的，有些是小的，但它们是非常非常强的虫子。

segments.en: They can live through anything.
segments.zh: 它们什么都能挺过来。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: They're small, usually brown, but sometimes I think you can see black cockroaches.
segments.zh: 它们很小，通常是棕色的，但有时我认为你可以看到黑色的蟑螂。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And they love to be near food and decaying things like garbage bins.
segments.zh: 它们喜欢靠近食物和腐烂的东西，比如垃圾箱。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So a very common type of pest, cockroach.
segments.zh: 所以是一种非常常见的害虫类型，蟑螂。

segments.en: And in order to get rid of termites and cockroaches and all these types of bugs, we have to fumigate the house.
segments.zh: 为了摆脱白蚁和蟑螂以及所有这些类型的虫子，我们必须熏蒸房子。

segments.en: Okay, so this is one method that the exterminator uses to kill bugs.
segments.zh: 好的，这是灭虫员用来杀虫的一种方法。

segments.en: And like in the dialogue, when you fumigate a house, basically you fill the house with fumes or gases that kill bugs.
segments.zh: 就像在对话中一样，当你熏蒸房子时，基本上你会用烟雾或气体杀死虫子。

segments.en: So people like you and me, we can't be in the house when that happens, right?
segments.zh: 所以像你我这样的人，发生这种情况时我们不能在家里，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Actually, if you see an exterminator, he will always fumigate wearing a mask so he doesn't inhale those poisonous gas.
segments.zh: 实际上，如果你看到一个灭虫者，他总是会戴着口罩熏蒸，这样他就不会吸入那些有毒气体。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's very dangerous for people and you'll have to make sure you talk to your exterminator to make sure that the gases he's using aren't getting into your body.
segments.zh: 所以这对人们来说非常危险，你必须确保和你的灭虫员沟通好，确保他使用的气体不会进入你的身体。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, so why don't we listen to the dialogue again and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们为什么不再听一次对话，我们会回来的。

segments.en: Hi, did you call for an exterminator?
segments.zh: 您好，您叫了灭虫服务吗？

segments.en: Yes, thank goodness you're here.
segments.zh: 是的，谢天谢地，你在这里。

segments.en: These bugs are driving us crazy.
segments.zh: 这些虫子快把我们逼疯了。

segments.en: What sort of pests are we dealing with?
segments.zh: 我们正在处理什么样的害虫？

segments.en: We just bought this house and it is infected with just about everything.
segments.zh: 我们刚买了这栋房子，结果什么虫害鼠害都有。

segments.en: We have termites in the wood, cockroaches all over the place, and last night I saw a huge rat out in the backyard.
segments.zh: 我们在树林里有白蚁，到处都是蟑螂，昨晚我在后院看到一只巨大的老鼠。

segments.en: Well there's nothing that we can't handle.
segments.zh: 放心，没有什么虫害是我们对付不了的。

segments.en: I'll spray the floorboards and walls to get rid of the cockroaches, but the termites will be harder to get rid of.
segments.zh: 我会喷洒地板和墙壁以摆脱蟑螂，但白蚁会更难摆脱。

segments.en: We will have to cover the entire house and fumigate it.
segments.zh: 得把整栋房子罩起来，做熏蒸处理。

segments.en: Unfortunately, that means you will have to find a place to stay for the next three days.
segments.zh: 不幸的是，这意味着您将不得不在接下来的三天内找到一个住宿的地方。

segments.en: No problem.
segments.zh: 没问题。

segments.en: Let's get rid of the bugs.
segments.zh: 咱们把虫子除掉吧。

segments.en: All right, so now we've chosen three key phrases for you on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在我们在流利表达上为您选择了三个关键短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: Well, this first phrase comes from the very beginning of today's dialogue.
segments.zh: 嗯，第一个短语来自今天对话的一开始。

segments.en: The second person in the dialogue says, these bugs are driving us crazy.
segments.zh: 对话中的第二个人说，这些虫子让我们发疯。

segments.en: So, to drive someone crazy.
segments.zh: 所以，让某人发疯。

segments.en: Okay, so if you're driving someone crazy, it means that you're making them crazy.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以如果你让某人发疯，这意味着你让他们发疯了。

segments.en: All right, so it could be you're making them angry or you're making them frustrated, but it has nothing to do with cars, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，所以可能是你让他们生气，或者你让他们感到沮丧，但这与汽车无关，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah, yeah, there's no driving involved.
segments.zh: 对，对，这里跟开车没关系。

segments.en: So driving here means making.
segments.zh: 所以这里的 driving 意思是“使得”。

segments.en: You're making me crazy.
segments.zh: 你让我发疯了。

segments.en: You're really making me frustrated.
segments.zh: 你真的让我很沮丧。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So in this case, the animals, the bugs were driving them crazy.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，动物，这些虫子把它们逼疯了。

segments.en: They were so annoying that they were just, they were very irritated.
segments.zh: 他们太烦人了，他们只是，他们非常恼火。

segments.en: So I could do something, Marco, that will drive you crazy.
segments.zh: 所以我可以做点什么，马可，这会让你发疯。

segments.en: I could tap, tap, tap, tap, tap, tap, tap.
segments.zh: 我可以敲，敲，敲，敲，敲，敲，敲。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: That's driving me crazy.
segments.zh: 这让我发疯。

segments.en: Doesn't it annoy you?
segments.zh: 不惹你生气吗？

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: So I'll stop.
segments.zh: 所以我会停下来。

segments.en: So it doesn't drive you crazy anymore.
segments.zh: 所以它不再让你发疯。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, so now obviously bugs are driving them crazy and she went on to explain that it's because the house is infested with just about everything.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以现在显然虫子把它们逼疯了，她接着解释说，这是因为房子里几乎什么虫都有。

segments.en: Well, this is a great phrase because we can say it in a lot of different contexts.
segments.zh: 嗯，这是一个很好的短语，因为我们可以在许多不同的环境中说出来。

segments.en: In this context, it means there is not everything, every single bug in the house, but just about everything.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，它的意思是房子里并非每一种虫子都有，而是几乎什么都有。

segments.en: That means almost every bug you can think of is in this house.
segments.zh: 这意味着你能想到的几乎每一种虫子都在这所房子里。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's kind of a way of exaggerating also because obviously, well, they have cockroaches, they have termites, but they're saying we have a lot of different types of bugs.
segments.zh: 所以这也是一种夸张的说法，因为显然他们有蟑螂、有白蚁，但他们说我们有很多不同类型的虫子。

segments.en: We have just about everything that you can imagine.
segments.zh: 我们几乎拥有您可以想象的一切。

segments.en: You could even say, this restaurant has just about every Chinese dish you could ever think of.
segments.zh: 你甚至可以说，这家餐厅几乎拥有你能想到的每一道中国菜。

segments.en: That's not true.
segments.zh: 那不是真的。

segments.en: It doesn't have every single one, but it has a lot.
segments.zh: 它没有每一个，但它有很多。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, so that's the way that you use just about everything.
segments.zh: 好的，这就是 just about everything 的用法。

segments.en: And for our final phrase, we use it a little bit earlier on.
segments.zh: 对于我们的最后一个短语，我们在前面稍微提到过。

segments.en: Let's explain it a little bit.
segments.zh: 让我们稍微解释一下。

segments.en: When we're talking about bugs, we want to get rid of bugs.
segments.zh: 当我们谈论虫子时，我们想除掉虫子。

segments.en: This is why we call the exterminator, to get rid of the cockroaches.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么我们称之为灭虫者，以摆脱蟑螂。

segments.en: You might hear this phrase a lot when you're watching movies about gangsters or mobsters like The Sopranos, the TV show, get rid of him.
segments.zh: 看关于黑帮或匪徒的电影时，比如电视剧《黑道家族》，你可能会经常听到这个短语——干掉他。

segments.en: So this is a phrase that means, in this case, to kill something or to kill someone, to get rid of it, to get rid of him.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个短语，在这种情况下，意味着杀死某物或杀死某人，摆脱它，摆脱他。

segments.en: To not have it anymore.
segments.zh: 不再拥有它。

segments.en: So rid means to get away or to throw away.
segments.zh: 所以 rid 的意思是摆脱或丢弃。

segments.en: But in this case, you're not just throwing it away, you're killing these bugs.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，你不只是把它扔掉，你是在杀死这些虫子。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we want to get rid of the bugs.
segments.zh: 所以我们想除掉这些虫子。

segments.en: Now obviously, as you said, we can also throw away, for example, these shoes are too old.
segments.zh: 现在很明显，正如你所说，我们也可以扔掉，例如，这些鞋太老了。

segments.en: I'm going to get rid of them.
segments.zh: 我要摆脱它们。

segments.en: Or, hey Marco, this milk smells funny.
segments.zh: 或者，嘿，Marco，这牛奶闻起来有股怪味。

segments.en: Can you get rid of it?
segments.zh: 你能摆脱它吗？

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So that's the way that you would use that phrase, to get rid of something.
segments.zh: 所以这就是你使用这个短语来摆脱某些东西的方式。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to our dialogue for the very last time and we're back to talk a little bit more.
segments.zh: 那么我们最后再听一遍对话，回来后再多聊一点。

segments.en: Hi, did you call for an exterminator?
segments.zh: 您好，您叫了灭虫服务吗？

segments.en: Yes, thank goodness you're here.
segments.zh: 是的，谢天谢地，你在这里。

segments.en: These bugs are driving us crazy.
segments.zh: 这些虫子快把我们逼疯了。

segments.en: What sort of pests are we dealing with?
segments.zh: 我们正在处理什么样的害虫？

segments.en: We just bought this house and it is infected with just about everything.
segments.zh: 我们刚买了这栋房子，结果什么虫害鼠害都有。

segments.en: We have termites in the wood, cockroaches all over the place.
segments.zh: 我们在树林里有白蚁，到处都是蟑螂。

segments.en: And last night I saw a huge rat out in the backyard.
segments.zh: 昨晚我在后院看到一只大老鼠。

segments.en: Well there's nothing that we can't handle.
segments.zh: 放心，没有什么虫害是我们对付不了的。

segments.en: I'll spray the floorboards and walls to get rid of the cockroaches, but the termites will be harder to get rid of.
segments.zh: 我会喷洒地板和墙壁以摆脱蟑螂，但白蚁会更难摆脱。

segments.en: We will have to cover the entire house and fumigate it.
